I was just about to make this PR lol. Here is a cleaner proof. Along with a golf and a generalization for the instance. I can still make this PR, or you can just apply this, whatever :)

Note that you need to strengthen the import to `Mathlib.Algebra.Central.Basic` in the `Mathlib/Algebra/Central/End` file.

```lean
import Mathlib

variable {R M : Type*} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
  [Module.Free R M] {f : Module.End R M} 

-- Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.Basic
theorem Module.End.mem_center_iff :
    f ∈ Set.center (End R M) ↔ ∃ α ∈ Set.center R, ∀ x : M, f x = α • x := by
  simp only [Semigroup.mem_center_iff, LinearMap.ext_iff, mul_apply]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by simp_all⟩
  by_cases! Subsingleton M
  · exact ⟨0, by simp, fun _ ↦ Subsingleton.allEq _ _⟩
  let b := Free.chooseBasis R M
  let i := b.index_nonempty.some
  have (x : M) := by simpa using h ((b.coord i).smulRight x) (b i) |>.symm
  exact ⟨b.coord i (f (b i)),
    fun r ↦ by simpa using congr(b.coord i $(this (r • b i))), this⟩

-- Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.Basic
theorem Module.End.mem_submonoidCenter_iff :
    f ∈ Submonoid.center (End R M) ↔
      ∃ α ∈ Submonoid.center R, ∀ x : M, f x = α • x :=
  Module.End.mem_center_iff

-- Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.Basic
theorem Module.End.mem_subsemigroupCenter_iff :
    f ∈ Subsemigroup.center (End R M) ↔
      ∃ α ∈ Subsemigroup.center R, ∀ x : M, f x = α • x :=
  Module.End.mem_center_iff

-- Mathlib.Algebra.Central.End
theorem Module.End.mem_subsemiringCenter_iff :
    f ∈ Subsemiring.center (End R M) ↔
      ∃ α ∈ Subsemiring.center R, ∀ x : M, f x = α • x :=
  Module.End.mem_center_iff

variable {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S] [Module S M]
  [SMulCommClass R S M] [Algebra S R] [IsScalarTower S R M]

-- Mathlib.Algebra.Central.End
theorem Module.End.mem_subalgebraCenter_iff :
    f ∈ Subalgebra.center S (End R M) ↔
      ∃ α ∈ Subalgebra.center S R, ∀ x : M, f x = α • x :=
  Module.End.mem_center_iff

attribute [-instance] Algebra.IsCentral.instEnd in
example [Algebra.IsCentral S R] : Algebra.IsCentral S (Module.End R M) where
  out x hT :=
    have ⟨α, h⟩ := Module.End.mem_subalgebraCenter_iff.mp hT
    have ⟨y, hy⟩ := Algebra.IsCentral.center_eq_bot S R ▸ h.1
    ⟨y, by aesop⟩
```
Please PR it, I can close mine, no problem.

files.patch:
@@ -11,13 +11,47 @@ public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.Basic
 /-!
 # `Module.End R M` is a central algebra
 
-This file shows that the algebra of endomorphisms on a free module is central.
+This file shows that the algebra of endomorphisms on a free module
+over a commutative semiring is central.
+
+* `Module.End.exists_apply_eq_smul`:
+in the noncommutative case, the center of `End R M` consists of homotheties with central ratio.
+
 -/
 
 open Module Free
 
 namespace Algebra.IsCentral
-variable {R M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Free R M]
+
+open Module.Free Module.Basis
+
+variable {R M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
+
+section
+
+variable [Semiring R] [Module R M] [Free R M]
+
+/-- The center of endomorphisms on a free module
+consists of homotheties with central ratio. -/
+theorem _root_.Module.End.exists_apply_eq_smul
+    (f : End R M) (hf : f ∈ Subsemiring.center (End R M)) :
+    ∃ a ∈ Subsemiring.center R, ∀ x, f x = a • x := by
+  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial M
+  · refine ⟨1, by simp, ?_⟩
+    intro; apply Subsingleton.allEq
+  let b := Free.chooseBasis R M
+  let i := b.index_nonempty.some
+  simp_rw [Subsemiring.mem_center_iff] at hf ⊢
+  suffices _ by
+    refine ⟨b.coord i (f (b i)),
+      fun r ↦ by simpa using congr(b.coord i $(this (r • b i))),
+      this⟩
+  intro y
+  simpa using congr($(hf ((b.coord i).smulRight y)) (b i)).symm
+
+end
+
+variable [CommSemiring R] [Module R M] [Free R M]
 
 /-- The center of endomorphisms on a free module is trivial,
 in other words, it is a central algebra. -/
